_comment: English human audio is OFF (Eric, 2026-09-20): the pilot clips are spoken ~1.4x faster than the voice they replaced (up to 1.6x on short words) and were hard to understand in play. The clips, verdicts and credits stay in the repo; re-listing a language here is what switches it back on, and tools/human-audio/bundle.py rewrites this file from the verdicts.
